label: Fashion style
description: Named outfit styles, fashion subcultures, street fashions, decade revivals, and costume aesthetics.
notes: Named ways of assembling an outfit belong here, with short style names that follow “dressed in” and precede “style.” clothing.traditional_dress owns named cultural garments and ensembles; clothing.fabric owns materials rather than complete looks. Decade revivals and costume genres remain available in contemporary scenes, without era, genre, or descent restrictions. Tiers describe how expected a look is in an open fashion draw; the explicitly fetish-coded entry is adult-only.
